Hi Samantha — thanks for the screenshot, that's helpful.

Quick troubleshooting notes:
- This looks like a truncated description in the ICS payload; some calendar clients (Outlook and older mobile apps) will hide the join link if the DESCRIPTION field is missing or contains long escaped tokens.
- I also see the organizer on the original invite is an aliased address (samantha@stellar-growth.com) which can lead to organizer-affinity issues for delegates.

Short-term fallback (if you want to avoid reissuing):
- We'll provision a temporary Zoom link and dial-in and send it to the full attendee list. That bypasses calendar client quirks.

Longer-term fix: I can reissue the invite from my account so the organizer field is a Redwood user and the ICS includes an explicit LOCATION/URL entry. That will show up consistently.

Ben and Olga — FYI, can one of you take host rights on the Zoom if we go that route? Ben, can you also confirm whether we should add an explicit ORGANIZER header when Vivek reissues (some Outlook configs require it)?

- Thu Jun 4, 09:00–09:30 PT
- Thu Jun 4, 11:00–11:30 PT

Adding a bit of context from the SE side — we've hit two similar cases this quarter:
1) Organizer alias + long encoded metadata in DESCRIPTION => Outlook hides the link.
2) Some Outlook tenants aggressively strip HTML and leave only plain text; if the URL isn't in a dedicated LOCATION or URL property, the Join button can vanish.

If we reissue from Vivek (or another @redwood.com organizer) I recommend these ICS changes:
- Set ORGANIZER to vivek@redwood.com
- Put the Meet/Zoom URL in LOCATION and include a short plain-text line at the top of the DESCRIPTION with the URL (no HTML).
- Add an X-Redwood-Invite-Version header so our support tools can identify patched invites later.

If Samantha prefers Zoom, I'm happy to stand up host on the Zoom account and send credentials. Pros and cons: Zoom adds an extra host step for compliance but is reliable across clients; reissuing Meet from our account is cleaner for audit trails.

I'll prepare the patched ICS and a one-line email we can blast to all attendees; Vivek, want me to draft that and the Zoom link (if needed)?

—Ben
